purpose: Canonical Vibe safe authoring defaults derived from Ordo language and Vibe architecture. Profiles are not language restrictions and are not bound to any single runtime adapter.

conditional_requirements: if model_result_contract.required_state_writes exists, authority_contract must runtime-enforce every required path
if the model proposes canonical state mutation, emit state_patch_v1 with base_state_sha256 and allowed_roots; deterministic runtime applies it
producer output is validated before persistence; invalid output keeps current node unchanged and produces no transition receipt

required: single transition to a separate deterministic gate
validate deterministic output before canonical state persistence
conditional_requirements: structured machine stdout may be consumed as $answer.* and committed mechanically before routing
if on_fail names a recovery node, FAIL routes there rather than becoming terminal blocked
re-entry after recovery is allowed even if target node was executed earlier
when recovery is repairable, deterministic recovery resume must identify the first invalid or missing milestone and non-null resume node
lifecycle reopen routes require evidence-bound reason and provenance when they downgrade a resolved state

forbidden: model semantic recovery to interpret authority
conditional_requirements: consequential analyst-owned decisions use stable decision_id
if multiple same-group consequential decisions are simultaneously known, exhaustive discovery precedes asking and they may be presented as one coherent authority batch
partial answers preserve resolved decision ids and only unresolved/new/conflicted ids are re-asked

required: analyst message treated as fact stream
all relevant supported facts may be extracted beyond active question
conditional_requirements: for substantive decisions, structural resolution_status is canonical; value text does not determine status
after semantic extraction, deterministic merge/recompute occurs before next question

required: at least one reachable incoming route unless it is the entry itself
